DLC2304:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...A rounded body, warm colors, and adorable, beady eyes...」

DLC2304:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I hear my design was decided by collecting the features women like, but somehow my charm doesn't seem to be getting across...」

DLC2304:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I am about to tell takes place about two weeks after $$サイデリアル$$ began its invasion... when its threat still seemed far away.」

DLC2304:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Back then, the members of the $$ボランティア部$$ could still attend $$陣代高校$$ fairly regularly.」

DLC2304:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Looking back now, perhaps those were their last peaceful days...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$! Why do you always do this!?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:7.en:
$$風間$$
「...$$相良$$ finally comes to school after all this time, and he's already causing a scene.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:8.en:
$$詩織$$
「What did he do this time?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:9.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Apparently a ball from the baseball club broke a window. As soon as $$相良$$ heard it, he suddenly tackled $$千鳥$$ to the ground.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:11.en:
$$風間$$
「He was shouting 'Get down!' so I think he was trying to protect her.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:12.en:
$$詩織$$
「He's still her knight in shining armor. Just a little off the mark...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:13.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Still, someone should stop them soon.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:14.en:
$$恭子$$
「Why don't we ask someone from the $$ボランティア部$$?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:15.en:
$$詩織$$
「But the only members who came to school today were $$相良$$ and $l...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:17.en:
$$風間$$
「He's quietly cleaning up the broken glass.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:18.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「That's the vice president of the $$ボランティア部$$ for you! Cleaning is his specialty!」

DLC2304:3:t_2:19.en:
$$詩織$$
「Then what do we do about $$かなめ$$ and $$相良$$?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:20.en:
$$恭子$$
「I think we should leave them alone. I'm sure $$カナ$$'s happy to see $$相良$$ after so long.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:21.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「A paper fan as an expression of love, huh...? I can't decide whether to envy him...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:22.en:
$$風間$$
「Then let's give them some time alone, since we can.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:23.en:
$$恭子$$
「See you, $$カナ$$. We're heading to $$オハイオ屋$$ ahead of you.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:24.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Honestly, $$宗介$$! You don't understand the first thing about how to treat a girl!」

DLC2304:3:t_2:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If an apology fixed everything, we wouldn't need the $$連邦軍$$!」

DLC2304:3:t_2:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Next time I see $$テッサ$$, I'm telling her! You're incapable of being a girl's bodyguard!」

DLC2304:3:t_2:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「That would call into question the operational judgment of the Colonel who assigned me to guard you.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh... really...? So you're brushing aside your own mistake to defend $$テッサ$$?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'd actually like to ask $$テッサ$$ whether there was any reason to choose you as my bodyguard besides your age and being Japanese.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:32.en:
$$宗介$$
（...Perhaps successfully completing that mission had something to do with it...）

DLC2304:3:t_2:39.en:
？？？
「Were you... the one who saved me?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「A secret military organization that belongs to no nation.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:43.en:
？？？
「What are you... going to do with me?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know that much. Our mission was only to rescue you.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:52.en:
$$宗介$$
（...At the time, I carried out the mission without question. But looking back, it was extremely strange for an organization of that scale to abduct a single girl...）

DLC2304:3:t_2:53.en:
$$宗介$$
（She must have been like $$千鳥$$ and the Colonel...）

DLC2304:3:t_2:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You spaced out halfway through! What on earth were you thinking about!?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:60.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course... Thinking about $$テッサ$$ is much more fun than listening to me yell at you after you risked your life on a mission...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「N-negative, $$千鳥$$! The woman I was thinking of wasn't the Colonel, but another...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:62.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Just how many women are you involved with!?」

DLC2304:3:t_2:64.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't follow me! I don't want to see your face for a while!」

DLC2304:3:t_2:66.en:
$n
「What's wrong, $$宗介$$? $$千鳥$$ just walked past looking furious...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:70.en:
$n
「H-hey... Where are you going, $$宗介$$!? We were going to have $$銀河ラーメン$$ after this...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:73.en:
$n
「...So, in the end, all I did at school was clean up broken glass...」

DLC2304:3:t_2:78.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Okay. I feel better for now.」

DLC2304:3:t_2:79.en:
$$かなめ$$
（Wasn't coming to the beach and yelling because I was upset a little too obvious, even for me...?）

DLC2304:3:t_2:80.en:
$$かなめ$$
（I'd better head home... $$宗介$$ hasn't been back in Japan for ages, so I'm sure he wants some Japanese cooking...）

DLC2304:3:t_2:81.en:
$$かなめ$$
（...Wait, what am I saying...? I just told him I didn't want to see his face for a while...）

DLC2304:3:t_2:85.en:
$$傭兵$$
「If you quietly follow our instructions, we have no intention of hurting you.」

review.context: Kaname's anger at Sousuke's overzealous protection becomes jealousy when he recalls rescuing a mysterious girl before his Jindai assignment. She goes to the beach and is cornered by kidnappers.
decisions: Harisen is rendered as a paper fan so the classroom gag is clear.
Sousuke's denial remains military 'Negative' while his accidental admission retains the other-woman misunderstanding.
The flashback's female referent is explicitly identified as a girl by narration; no unknown gender is inferred.
Deliberately interrupted mission and threat lines remain unfinished.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
uncertainties: Ohio-ya is a provisional spelling for the shop name absent from the supplied glossary; orchestrator was asked to verify it.
